steps.title: The shoulder
steps.body: The reed is opened at a long shallow angle so the ink has somewhere to sit. Cut it short and the pen runs dry mid-letter.

steps.title: The slit
steps.body: One press splits the nib down the centre. It has to stop exactly where the shoulder ends, or the two halves will spread under pressure.

steps.title: The qatt
steps.body: The tip is trimmed against the qat'ah at the angle your script needs — flat for thuluth, oblique for nastaliq. This is the cut you cannot take back.
